name: Run trace shows the Project context block and the Project Context page shows the not-cloned state
description: SPEC-01 AC-9 + AC-5. Open seeded PR #482, open the seeded run's trace from the Agent runs tab and confirm the Project context block lists the included doc and the too-large doc (seed.ts → seedReviewRun). Then go to the sidebar Project Context page of acme/payments-api, which has no clone, and confirm the blocking not-cloned state. Never clicks Resync (that would start a job) and never waits for a failed/degraded index banner: the seeded repo is never in a listed state. The trace drawer is a full-screen overlay with no Escape handler, so the flow reloads the app root before clicking the sidebar link. Preconditions: freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo.
